currentContext.expansion: The annual report discloses no named capex project, no capacity addition and no commissioning timeline. Expansion is framed entirely as product and market widening rather than plant build-out: the Company says it is in the process of commercialising new specialty chemicals/intermediates developed in-house for use in multiple industries including pharmaceuticals, and that RSL is in the process of adding many intermediates to its product list while reaching out to end users in many major countries. On the technology side, the in-house R&D Centre at Tarapur, recognised by the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research, Government of India, is working on catalysis for fluidized-bed and fixed-bed reactions, and the Company states it is undertaking major projects to develop alternate and efficient processes for making pyridine-based products, having already achieved better yields and resulting cost reduction from R&D in plant processes. The manufacturing facility is described as continuing to adhere to cGMP and being ISO 9000:2015 certified, with products also Kosher, Halal and FSSC certified. The Board report states no material changes or commitments affecting the financial position occurred between the year-end and the date of the report.
